sourceText: Sijui kama unatambua hili au la, lakini nyingi ya bidhaa kutoka Marekani ya Kati ziliingia humu nchini bila kulipiwa ushuru.
referenceText: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
